# #2633 asks about a PAIR of modules -- "compile a module with the lib_6_3
# target profile that exports some functions, and import those in a separate
# file" -- so the repro is a pair, and every release is asked both halves.
#
# line 1: the IMPORT half (@s-perron's own case, retargeted to lib_6_3).
# line 2: the EXPORT half.
#
# Neither line carries -fspv-target-env=universal1.5, deliberately. That flag
# is the one under which an export module is actually valid, but it was added
# by the very PR that added export linkage (#3234), so putting it in cmd.txt
# would make every older release fail on the FLAG rather than answer whether it
# can emit linkage at all. At the default (Vulkan) target env a release that
# generates linkage says so anyway: its own validator rejects
# `OpCapability Linkage` and echoes the instruction. The universal1.5 form is
# captured separately as variant-export-universal15-*.
-T lib_6_3 -spirv repro.hlsl
-T lib_6_3 -spirv lib-export.hlsl
